Live this returns 200 and serves page-1 content (silent no-advance loop), NOT 404. DB template '/page/{N}/' is correct (genuine page advance, zero overlap). LATENT for alsimmons: catalog-crawler.ts:280 takes the API path primary; HTML pagination (and thus this bug) only fires on API failure (catalog-crawler.ts:362 `if (!apiCrawlUsed ...)`).

Only python-requests bot UA gets 403. hasWaf:true (DB) forces ensureCookies Playwright solve on every fetchCatalogPage and throws WAF_COOKIE_FAILED on solve failure -> HTML fallback capped at 177 in-stock. hasWaf:true+cloudflare-passive is the invalid over-throttle combo; hasWaf:false (R1 blind) is correct.
